nodes.label: Glowing Tree with Tech Roots Animation Sequence (Frames 084-160)
nodes.description: AI-generated animation sequence (frames 084-160) depicting a stylized green tree with glowing blue neon roots and two flanking crystalline/glass sculptural forms on a dark background. The sequence shows a continuous looping or transitional animation of the tree motif with bioluminescent root systems, produced via Veo (Google AI video generation). Represents a nature-meets-technology visual theme.
